notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
description:
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Arcane Adaptation, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
